exposure: Information received about birth types during prenatal visits
Women who changed their birth type preferences vs. those who did not
Access to prenatal follow-up visits during the COVID-19 pandemic
Worries about giving birth in hospital during the COVID-19 pandemic
cohort: 315 pregnant women in their third trimester
finding: COVID-19 phobia was positively correlated with perinatal anxiety and may have contributed to some women changing their birth type preferences in favor of cesarean section.
mod_finding: During the COVID-19 pandemic, 4.1% of the participants changed their birth type preferences, with a statistically significant shift towards cesarean section.
